errors.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Sign in again and retry.
errors.no_file: No image was received. Try capturing again.
errors.unsupported_type: That file type isn't supported. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.file_too_large: That image is too large. Try again with a smaller photo.
errors.provider_not_configured: Scanning isn't set up on this server yet.
errors.provider_failed: Couldn't read the document. Try again, or enter the values manually.
errors.unreadable_document: The image couldn't be read. Try a sharper, better-lit photo.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

notices.currencyMismatch: This document is in {documentCurrency}, but your household records everything in {householdCurrency}. Saving is blocked because totals would be wrong. Enter it manually if the amount is genuinely in {householdCurrency}.
notices.typeMismatch: This doesn't look like the kind of document expected here, so nothing was filled in. Check you scanned the right page.
notices.sampleData: Sample data — no scanning service is configured, so these values are invented, not read from your document. Don't save them as-is.
notices.lowConfidence: {count, plural, one {# value was hard to read} other {# values were hard to read}}: {fields}. Check them against the document before saving.
